articleTitle: A DWDM MM-wave fiber-radio system by optical frequency interleaving for high spectral efficiency
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: We propose a simple method for fully utilizing optical bandwidth of DWDM millimeter-wave fiber-radio systems by optical frequency interleaving. Preliminary experiment with the channel separation of only 10 GHz showed the interchannel-crosstalk induced power penalty of 2.7 dB.

articleTitle: Dynamic optical transversal filters based on a tunable dispersion fiber Bragg grating
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: We demonstrate a fibre optic radio frequency notch filter with continuous tuning by using a uniform fibre Bragg grating. The uniform grating is dynamically chirped by using a magnetic field and a magnetostrictive transducer.

articleTitle: High performance microwave link using a multimode VCSEL and a high-bandwidth multimode fiber
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Using a multimode VCSEL and a high-bandwidth multimode fiber we have obtained a spurious free dynamic range exceeding 94 dBHz/sup 2/3/ in the frequency range 1-8 GHz over a transmission distance of 300 m.

articleTitle: 32-QAM radio transmission over multimode fibre beyond the fibre bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: We show for the first time that radio frequency transmission over multimode fibre beyond the fibre bandwidth is a practical option for distributed antenna systems. 32-QAM transmission at 2 GHz is performed with negligible penalty.

articleTitle: Fiber-optic transmission of 60 GHz DBPSK signal employing the dual-mode PSK modulation (DMPM) method
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Demonstrated successfully a 20 km fiber-optic transmission of a 156 Mb/s-DBPSK 60 GHz optical mm-wave signal with a new modulation technique employed; the dual-mode phase shift keying modulation (DMPM) method that we have proposed for the use in advanced mm-wave fiber-radio systems based on the passive base stations (PBSs). The experiment was performed to investigate the DMPM performance from a realistic viewpoint, and the following attractive features were confirmed for its PBS application; high modulation index, high dispersion tolerance and compactness.

articleTitle: Multi-gigabit/s wireless links using millimeter-wave photonic techniques
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: We show multi-gigabit/s wireless links based on millimeter-wave photonic techniques. Wireless data transmission at 2.5 Gbit/s was achieved by using a high-power 120 GHz photonic emitter. The wireless link has been successfully applied to the optical Gigabit/s Ethernet.

articleTitle: Error-free DWDM transmission of 60-GHz-band fiber-radio signals with square-like response fiber Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: A novel DWDM spectrum design for millimeter-wave-band fiber-radio signals with square-like response fiber Bragg grating (FBG) filters is proposed. Error-free DWDM transmission of 60.0-GHz, 155.52Mb/s-DPSK fiber-radio signals with the specially prepared FBGs is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: A fibre Bragg grating based scanning receiver for electronic warfare applications
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: An all-optical scanning receiver system for Electronic Warfare (EW) applications has been demonstrated. The system employs wavelength scanning of optically modulated RF sidebands through the narrow bandwidth central transmission peak of a phase-shifted fibre Bragg grating. High-speed wavelength scanning may be employed via current modulation of a semiconductor diode laser. The all-optical nature of this system allows for a lightweight fibre optic implementation that is simple to fabricate and employs low-speed electronic processing at the system output. The system exhibits a sensitivity of 73 dBm and a frequency resolution of 50 MHz over a 20 GHz bandwidth.

articleTitle: Full-duplex demonstration of single electroabsorption transceiver basestation for mm-wave fiber-radio systems
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Full-duplex, 156 Mbit/s, 60 GHz-band millimeter-wave fiber-radio signal transmission over 25 km-long fiber is experimentally demonstrated for the first time by using single two-RF-port EAT. The approach to single-EAT-BS will become a powerful candidate for fiber-radio access systems.

articleTitle: A simple linearity analysis for active distributed antenna systems using W-CDMA signals
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: This paper presents a simple method for calculating the adjacent channel leakage power ratio for active distributed antenna systems using W-CDMA signals, based on parameters obtained from measurement of two-tone intermodulation distortion.

articleTitle: A broadband integrated photonic-antenna interface for multiservice millimeter-wave fiber-wireless applications
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: A broadband integrated photonic-antenna interface is presented that is suitable for application in multiple millimeter-wave fiber-wireless service applications. The antenna base-station module is based on hybrid integrated circuit technology and operates over the entire Ka-band (26 - 40 GHz).

articleTitle: Semiconductor optical amplifiers for microwave photonics links
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: The influence of saturated Semiconductor Optical Amplifiers "SOA" (classical or gain clamped) on the transmission characteristics of a fibre optical link carrying a microwave signal is presented. SOAs present different behaviour in term of gain, nonlinearity, frequency response and noise in accordance with the modulation frequency of the input signal.

articleTitle: All optical wideband microwave noise filter
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: A novel configuration of fiber-optic link is demonstrated which forms a passive microwave noise reduction filter. This circuit is designed to suppress unwanted RF amplitude noise arising from either the transmission laser due to relative intensity noise (RIN), or from an optical amplifier in the form of amplified spontaneous emission (ASE). The optics can be configured to select the center RF frequency of the noise filter as well as the depth and bandwidth for filtering.

articleTitle: Fiber radio: from links to networks
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Various fiber radio link architectures have been developed to transmit modulated microwave or MM-wave signals over fiber. However, the issue of how to integrate these links into a network topology remains an open issue. This paper addresses one method that can be used to develop a transparent fiber radio network.

articleTitle: Generation of MSK modulated millimeter wave subcarrier for radio over fiber applications
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: In this paper we report on the generation of MSK modulated MM-wave subcarrier using a highspeed tunable optical transmitter. The millimeter wave signal is generated by beating the output of two Nd:YVO/sub 4//MgO:LiNbO/sub 3/ electro-optically tunable single mode microchip lasers realized monolithically in a single composite crystal. By applying a digital voltage signal to the electro-optic section, MSK modulation is impressed onto the millimeter wave subcarrier. Experimentally, an 8 MHz symbol rate MSK signal at 8 GHz carrier frequency was successfully generated and analyzed.

articleTitle: Separating DC biasing from RF modulation in EO polymer modulators integrated with mechanical resonators
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: DC biasing and RF modulation of polymer modulators are separated by heterogeneously integrating them with mechanical resonators. Feasibility of integration with MEMS is investigated, and biasing is experimentally demonstrated by integration with a piezoelectric element.

articleTitle: Ultra wide-band electroabsorption modulator modules for DC to millimeter-wave band
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Two types of electroabsorption (EA) modulators, a selected-band EA modulator and an ultra wide-band EA modulator, have been developed. The selected-band EA modulator, which has a matching circuit, is suitable for MM-wave band fiber-radio systems. The ultra wide-band EA modulator covers frequencies from DC to 50 GHz.

articleTitle: Optical SSB modulation using fiber Bragg gratings and the impact of grating dispersion on transmission performance
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: We investigate the effect of fiber Bragg grating dispersion when used as an optical filter to generate optical single sideband modulation for fiber dispersion compensation in MM-wave fiber-wireless systems. Our results show that power penalties occur due to grating dispersion across the bandwidth of the transmitted data which requires optimization of the grating dispersion.

articleTitle: Optical generation of tunable microwave signal from a dual mode fiber grating DFB laser
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Optical generation of a tunable microwave signal is realized using a dual mode fiber grating DFB laser. A linewidth of 1 kHz of beat frequency is achieved and fine-tuning is demonstrated in this work.

articleTitle: A 6-bit programmable photonic true time delay line for RF photonics applications
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: We demonstrate a 6-bit programmable photonic true time delay line device that offers low insertion loss and fast switching speed. This device provides an off-the-shelf solution to RF photonics applications.

articleTitle: AM mode-locked fibre ring laser generating highly stable, higher-order optical pulse trains with a wavelength tuning range of 1535 nm -1560 nm
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Highly stable, higher-order optical pulses are generated in an AM mode-locked fibre ring laser via intra-cavity optical filtering. We show that a modulation signal which is a sub-harmonic multiple of the 3.48 GHz free spectral range of Fabry-Perot etalon can be used to generate optical pulses at a repetition frequency of 3.477 GHz with amplitude noise of 0.93% and a timing jitter of 1.2 ps. The laser is tunable over a wavelength range of 1535-1560 nm.

articleTitle: High-efficiency directly modulated laser links
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: We report a new type of high-performance RF-lightwave transmitter, which can provide >10 dB RF insertion gain at <0 dBm optical power with high spur-free dynamic range and low noise characteristics in an analog fiber link The insertion gain of the transmitter is obtained from the device FM-gain provided by a high-FM -efficiency laser and a high slop efficiency FM discriminator. An integrated version of such a device will be ideal for future RF-photonic links.

articleTitle: Micro-optical resonators and applications in optoelectronic oscillator
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Whispering gallery mode resonators are attractive elements for photonics applications, since they offer extremely high quality factors (as high as 1010) with a small size. We have applied microresonators in the realization of a high performance, and small size optoelectronic oscillator (OEO). Specifically, we have studied the use of microspherical resonators as the optical delay element in the optoelectronic feedback loop of the OEO, and a highly efficient lithium niobate modulator based on a micro-resonator.

articleTitle: Lightwave single sideband source using a wavelength self-tunable InP:Fe filter for fibre-wireless systems
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: A novel wavelength self-tunable single sideband optical filter in iron-doped indium phosphide is presented and experimentally demonstrated. A 16 GHz fiber radio 140 Mbit/s data transmission was realized.

articleTitle: High skirt selectivity photonics-based bandpass filters
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: A new photonic signal processor topology, using a dual-cavity structure with optical gain offset, which simultaneously achieves both high-Q and high skirt selectivity filter response is presented. A 7-fold improvement of skirt selectivity in comparison to conventional high-Q structures is demonstrated.

articleTitle: WDM/SCM optical fiber backbone for 60 GHz wireless systems
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: A WDM/SCM fiber backbone based on multiple self-pulsating DFB lasers is demonstrated for broadband 60 GHz wireless networks. The architecture proposed allows sharing of optically generated 60 GHz millimeter-wave sources and simplification of the architecture of base stations.

articleTitle: LiNbO/sub 3/ modulators: status and advanced concepts for microwave signal processing
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: The status of the LiNbO/sub 3/ integrated optical circuit technology is reviewed and compared with the alternative solutions for wide bandwidth processing of microwave signals. The advantages of external modulation over direct laser diode modulation of optical radiation in fiber optic systems, mainly in terms of bandwidth and chirping, drove the development of LiNbO/sub 3/ based fabrication technologies of integrated optical modulators at a very high maturity level, which makes LiNbO/sub 3/ advantageous also over other external modulation solutions: semiconductors, electroabsorption, electro-optical polymers. Advanced concepts are presented to face some of the critical issues in the optical signal processing of microwave signals in defence systems (phased array radars, ECM, ESM) and consumer applications.

articleTitle: An optically sampled wideband digital receiver
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Phase-encoded optical sampling allows the processing of RF and microwave signals with high linearity and >60-dB signal-to-noise ratio in an optically sampled digital receiver. The wide analog-input bandwidth (>1 GHz) enables novel processing capabilities as demonstrated for a 250-MHz-bandwidth chirped signal undersampled at 60 MS/s.

articleTitle: Analysis of intra-step-barrier quantum wells for high-power electroabsorption modulators
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: We present analysis and preliminary experimental results of intra-step-barrier quantum wells for high-saturation-optical-power electroabsorption modulators. We have shown that the intra-step-barrier delays the onset of red shift in the quantum-confined Stark effect to a higher field.

articleTitle: Terahertz frequency mode-locking of monolithic compound-cavity laser diodes incorporating photonic-bandgap reflectors
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Semiconductor lasers are modelocked at a harmonic of the round-trip frequency with pulse repetition rates up to 2.1 THz. The devices incorporate a monolithic compound cavity with a photonic-bandgap reflector. Possible applications include local oscillators and optical clocks.

articleTitle: Second generation millimeter wave electro-optic polymer modulators
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: New millimeter-wave designs have been use to develop broadband polymer modulators which operate in a push-pull configuration for low drive voltages. Long term operation at optical power levels exceeding 20 mW has been demonstrated. These developments have enabled novel RF-photonic applications such as high-frequency optoelectronic oscillators, arrays of millimeter-wave phase shifters, and SSB modulators.

articleTitle: Efficient wideband printed antennas on lithium niobate for OEICs
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: A printed antenna structure for integration with LiNbO/sub 3/ based opto-electronic devices is presented. The design is based on the hi-lo stacked patch element, which yields a high efficiency broadband antenna. Experimental verification of the printed antenna is given.

articleTitle: Photonic transport for broadband wireless access and personal communications services
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: A DWDM photonic transport has been developed. The system is capable of distributing multiple communication services including PCS and broadband wireless access, making the deployment of these services quicker and less expensive. Each DWDM channel has an RF bandwidth of 1 to 3 GHz and can transport services up to 80 km.

articleTitle: RF photonics for simultaneous multiple TTD beamforming for 2-D antenna arrays
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: An all-optical implementation for broadband 2-D array multi-beam steering is presented. A key component of these beamformers is a novel multistage technique for non-mechanical image rotation that is used to turn 2-D beam-steering into a 1-D true time delay problem.

articleTitle: Influence of unselected master laser sidebands on the spectral characteristics of beat signals in sideband injection-locking
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: We have investigated the effects of unselected master laser sidebands in optical millimeter-wave generation using sideband injection-locking. The presence of unselected sidebands combined with chromatic dispersion can influence the spectral characteristics of the resulting beat signals.

articleTitle: A novel 1.55 /spl mu/m HBT-electroabsorption modulator
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: We present a novel waveguide electroabsorption modulator (EAM), integrated into the collector region of a heterostructure bipolar transistor (HBT). The novel device shows an optical modulation contrast of 7.5 dB and a 3 dB cut-off frequency of 7 GHz.

articleTitle: 110 GHz opto-electronic frequency synthesiser using optical comb generator and uni-travelling-carrier photodiode
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Using optical comb generation, SG-DBR laser comb line selection and uni-travelling-carrier photodiode, opto-electronic generation of 10 GHz to 110 GHz, -80 dBc/Hz SSB phase noise millimetre wave signals at powers up to 2 mW is demonstrated using no electrical amplification.

articleTitle: Two dimensional optical signal processing beamformer using multi-layer polymeric optical waveguide arrays
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: An optical heterodyne technique is a very effective procedure for a phased array antenna to generate and control a microwave signal with a particular phase shift. We developed a two-dimensional (2-D) Fourier transform optical signal processing (OSP) beam forming network (BFN). In the OSP-BFN, we use multi-layer polymeric optical waveguide arrays to make a 2-D specific phase-front and sample 2-D distributed light beams. These multi-layer optical waveguide arrays consist of three layers and 13 waveguides (4+5+4). We experimentally demonstrated 2-D beam steering in the X-band. Experimental results confirm the feasibility of the 2-D OSP-BFN.

articleTitle: Demonstration of broadband true-time delay with optical coherent transients
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: True time-delay of multi-gigabit per second signal was experimentally demonstrated using optical coherent transient (OCT) techniques. Delay accuracy of 1 picosecond and delay resolution of 7 picoseconds was achieved.

articleTitle: Optical delivery of millimetre-wave carriers using double injection locking
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: A system using double injection locking with an optical injection phase-lock loop source and an optically injection-locked oscillator receiver has been demonstrated. Substantial advantages are found in terms of power and noise performance, compared to using a photodetector-based receiver.

articleTitle: Multi-octave photonic RF synthesiser based on two DFB lasers
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Multi-octave photonic synthesis of high purity RF signals is demonstrated in a setup based around two DFB lasers. By using a 4 GHz to 14 GHz reference, 4 GHz to 60 GHz optical heterodyne signals were generated by FM sideband injection locking.

articleTitle: Frequency conversion for WDM applications using polymer traveling-wave electro-optic devices
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Frequency conversion of optical waves as a result of refraction through a moving interface in traveling-wave electro-optic phase modulators is analyzed. Two configurations of a device performing conversion are proposed, and their operating requirements are determined.

articleTitle: Efficient direct electrical locking of colliding pulse mode-locked lasers on semiinsulating substrate
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Efficient direct locking of colliding pulse mode-locked lasers on semi-insulating substrates was demonstrated. Low timing jitter of 0.69 ps was obtained under the fundamental hybrid mode-locking (FH-ML) case with an injected RF power of +8 dBm at a repetition rate of 36 GHz.

articleTitle: Experimental adaptive beam forming with polarization read-write multiplexing using BEAMTAP
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: In this paper, we present experimental results demonstrating broadband beam forming on simulated signals from a phased-array using a true-time-delay RF photonic processor implementing the BEAMTAP (Broadband Efficient Adaptive Method for True-time-delay Array Processing) algorithm.

articleTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: external modulators; RF signal generation; fiber radio systems and techniques; signal processing; optically controlled antennas; and microwave photonics techniques.

articleTitle: Dual-parallel electroabsorption modulated laser for analog optical transmitter
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: We demonstrated experimentally the reduction of nonlinearity of an InGaAs/InGaAsP quantum-well electro-absorption (EA) modulator by a dual-parallel modulation scheme at 8 GHz frequency range. Through the experiments, the IMD3, which is the dominant nonlinear product in narrowband, was suppressed by 23 dB and the following 19.6 dB enhancement of SFDR were archived.

articleTitle: Developments in coherent beamforming for compact phased array antennas
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: A novel, compact photonic RF beamformer is described as well as the optical components developed to realise the system. These components include stabilised YAG and DFB lasers and a Micro-Electro-Mechanical Spatial Light Modulator (MEM-SLM).

articleTitle: Self-aligned MSM low-temperature-grown GaAs traveling wave photodetector for 810 nm and 1230 nm
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Traveling wave photodetectors (TWPD) are promising devices for high bandwidth and high efficiency. In this paper, electro-optic sampling measurements of this novel self-aligned metal-semiconductor-metal TWPD under different biases and pumping levels are performed at a wavelength of 810 nm and the electrical sampling measurements are performed at a wavelength of 1230 nm.

articleTitle: Equal amplitude optical pulse generation at higher-order repetition frequency in fibre ring lasers using intra-cavity Fabry-Perot etalon and rational harmonic mode-locking
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Demonstrates the generation of equal amplitude higher-order optical pulse trains in a rational harmonically mode-locked fibre ring laser using a novel technique which is based on modulator nonlinearity and optical filtering via intra-cavity Fabry-Perot etalon. The generated optical pulses exhibit a large suppression of supermode noise, a low amplitude noise of 0.5% and a timing jitter of 0.44 ps. The laser is tunable over a wavelength range of 1535-1565 nm.

articleTitle: 130 Gsample/s photonic analog to digital converter
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Digital processing of the received signals in radar systems leads to higher performance and the ability to rapidly reconfigure such systems. Typically, the analog-to-digital converter (ADC) is the major bottleneck in realizing the digital receiver. Time stretch (TS) preprocessing is a new photonic based approach that can potentially boost the capability of the available electronic ADCs (Coppinger et al, 1999; Bhushan et al, 2000). In this approach, the analog signal is imposed on a chirped optical carrier using an electro-optic modulator. This time to wavelength mapped signal is then dispersed and hence stretched in time prior to digitization by the electronic ADC. Time stretching increases the effective sampling rate and input bandwidth of the ADC. We demonstrate a photonic ADC with a time stretch preprocessor. The system has a sampling rate of 130 GSa/s and a signal-to-noise ratio exceeding 7 effective number of bits.

articleTitle: Millimeter-wave fiber radio using subharmonic local-oscillator distribution
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: A millimeter-wave fiber radio system based on optical distribution of subharmonic local oscillator is described. Low frequency microwave subcarriers are optically transmitted to the base station, where the millimeter-wave carrier is generated by high-order frequency multiplication and frequency mixing is performed. The system architecture considers both down- and up-streams. Experimental results are given for Ka-band applications.

articleTitle: Novel photonic RF receiver using tunable Brillouin filtering and optical mixing
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a broadband swept frequency RF receiver using tunable Brillouin filtering and optical mixing. Preliminary experiments confirm successful image suppression and wide bandwidth operation.

articleTitle: Planar antennas for microwave photonics
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Planar antennas are often called upon to bridge the gap between the photonics and microwave fields. Design of such antennas requires a culmination of knowledge acquired from the study of both research areas. This paper discusses the authors' efforts in the design of novel planar antenna structures for microwave-photonics applications, which stress a high level of integration of photonics and microwave components.

articleTitle: A compact prototype optical processor for X-band arrays
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Presents the realization and preliminary characterization of a compact two-channel optical processor for an X-band antenna array. This lens array partially separates the signals based on their angle of arrival. The received audio-modulated signals, downconverted to HF band, drive a two-channel electro-optic modulator. The optical beam is carrier suppressed and sent to a miniature adaptive photorefractive oscillator that separates the signals based on their strength and correlation. The optical output is detected, demodulated and sent to a speaker. The system fits in a 33/spl times/45/spl times/15cm briefcase and consumes less than 20W. The prototype is also equipped with portable transmitters for on-site demonstration purposes.

articleTitle: Microwave spectrum analyzer based on spectral hole burning
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: The spectral hole burning (SHB) technology is considered for >10 GHz instantaneous bandwidth signal processing applications. In this context we report on the first demonstration of a SHB microwave spectrometer. The present setup is confined to narrow bandwidth operation.

articleTitle: Wideband true-time-delay system using fiber Bragg grating prism incorporated with a wavelength tunable fiber laser source
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: This paper presents some experimental results of a wideband true-time-delay system.. This system consists of a wavelength tunable fiber ring laser and a photonics time-delay unit constructed using discrete fiber Bragg gratings in combination with a chirped grating to increase the microwave frequency.

articleTitle: Wideband all-optical BEAMTAP
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: A holographically-cohered approach to the all-optical implementation of time-delay-and-sum array processing for large, wideband adaptive-beamforming and jammer-nulling antenna arrays that requires only two coherent-fiber tapped-delay-lines with 20 GHz squint-free bandwidth capability is presented.

articleTitle: Analytic solutions for distortion products in P(i)N photodiodes
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: In analog communication links, photodiodes generate frequency dependent intermodulation products as a result of space charge saturation. Previous analyses have been restricted to numerical methods. We describe analytic solutions for the distortions to third order.

articleTitle: Linearization of quantum well electro-absorption modulator by quantum well intermixing technique for analog optical links
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: A Quantum Well Intermixing (QWI) technique has been introduced to modify the transfer function of quantum well electroabsorption (EA) modulator for analog optical links. The linearization of transfer function of EA modulator has been achieved by introducing QW absorption regions differently intermixed each other along the waveguide. A 39.6 dB of IMD2 (2nd order intermodulation distortion) suppression and a 3.6 dB of SFDR (Spurious Free Dynamic Range) enhancement have been achieved.

articleTitle: 1.55 /spl mu/m surface excited monolithically integrated balanced metal-semiconductor-metal photodetectors and coplanar waveguide
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Two metal-semiconductor-metal (MSM) photodetectors are integrated monolithically with coplanar waveguide transmission line. By illuminating this structure with CW light and taking the difference between the two detectors, 9-10 dB noise cancellation was achieved. Another demonstration of noise cancellation is then proposed. Measurements show that the noise can be reduced by 3 dB without degrading the signal to noise ratio.

articleTitle: Noise performance analysis and improvement method for a millimeter-wave photoreceiver
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: A noise analysis of a 30 GHz photodiode plus matched amplifier photoreceiver is presented and a method for noise performance improvement described. It is shown that a 12.4 dB improvement in optical sensitivity can be achieved.

articleTitle: Ultra-fast optical time division multiplexing
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Recent progress in ultrahigh speed optical transmission using time-domain signal processing is reviewed including optical short pulse generation, time-domain multiplexing/demultiplexing and timing extraction. A 120 Gbit/s system prototype is described.

articleTitle: Laser stabilisation for use in microwave photonics
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Demonstrates a 50 dB improvement to the close-in phase noise spectra of diode-pumped YAG lasers and DFB laser diodes by locking the outputs to a fibre-optic delay line frequency discriminator.

articleTitle: Optical processing of microwave signals
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Several optical techniques and optical approaches to process microwave signals are presented. These optical processing techniques stand for functionalities such as filtering, time-domain processing (time stretching, time reversal, etc.), true-time delay lines, reduction of noise and nonlinear distortion, and digital modulation formats.

articleTitle: Radio on fiber system for personal digital cellular and IMT-2000
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: This paper proposes and experimentally confirms a Radio on Fiber system (ROF) with Sub-Carrier Multiplexing (SCM) that can transmit simultaneously both Personal Digital Cellular (PDC) and IMT-2000 signals for all operators in Japan. System configuration and RF characteristic are presented.

articleTitle: Timing extraction using direct optical injection locking of a relaxation oscillator based on an InP/InGaP/InGaAs resonant tunnel diode
publicationTitle: 2001 International Topical Meeting on Microwave Photonics. Technical Digest. MWP'01 (Cat. No.01EX476)
abstract: Direct optical injection locking of an InP/InGaP/InGaAs Resonant Tunnel Diode relaxation oscillator was used for error free timing extraction in a 2.5 Gbit/s optoelectronic receiver.
